candidates.title: Draft a school document filing checklist

demandEvidence.chore: Specific chore: prepare a draft checklist for operator supplied fictional school document summaries; staff determine category, retention and filing.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: hantering av post och inkommande dokument

ease.reason: A fictional document list could test a filing checklist; no attached reference demonstrates document classification.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: schools may value less filing work; this paid role does not establish AI service demand.

feasibility.reason: A checklist mock is bounded, but school categories, formats and retention rules are absent; no relevant implementation reference is attached.

autonomy.reason: A draft might group operator supplied fictional summaries; staff must inspect every item and decide filing and retention.

evidence.reason: The fresh notice names incoming documents and school document archiving, but gives no formats, frequency or rules.

candidates.reason: Assessed as a narrow fictional-input experiment; five-criterion mean is below the publish threshold. Relevant implementation support is absent from the attached references.
